layout.title: 98″ corner TV · 6-seat L facing it
notes: The TV angles across the south-east corner on a 56″ corner console, so the main run and the return both face it: no seat looks away from the screen.
L sectional 44″ deep, 18″ off the west glass (room for shades). Main run 106″ (y 41–147) with two 28½″ seats plus the corner, 4″ clear of the column; return 136″ (x 18–154) with three 29″ seats.
Seats sit 8′3″–13′8″ from the screen, which fills 29–43° of view; four seats are prime, two are good.
Coffee table: Living Spaces Aries II cocktail ottoman, 66 × 27 × 18″, with the 30 × 24″ MAGIGO walnut tray (both from ideas/README.md), 16″ from both seat fronts.

findings: terra: no measured shortfall with a buildable fix; tape the column north edge (modeled y 37) and check door hardware before ordering.
sonnet: nothing to fix; seats 3 and 6 stay good, not prime, and no alternative fixes that without losing a seat. The seat table rounded 28.5-inch seats to 29 (fixed).

grok: would not move it again. The only residue is the north edge 3 inches past the balcony jamb (y 147 vs 144), forced by a 106-inch run; a 102-inch run fixes it at the cost of 26.5-inch main seats, which grok would not take.
outcome: All three reviewers at 9 or above on every criterion. Final layout.
